Reuse the admitted v20 case only for zap_dig→pit_flow. Independently record the other active caller routes: both dighole sites, do_break_wand, do_pit from do_earthquake, and blow_up_landmine. Caller edits remain branch-local and earn no whole caller credit. A95 confirmed its zap.js edits are limited to separate ZT_ACID arms; C79 owns map and clairvoyance functions.

functions.name: liquid_flow
branches: Validate is_pool_or_lava; under sanity_check, format an invalid-terrain diagnostic using trapname(..., TRUE).
Delete ttmp before releasing ice or unearthing buried objects.
Print the optional fill message with hliquid after exposing objects.
Damage floor objects before selecting hero pooleffects(FALSE) or monster minliquid.

functions.name: trapname
branches: Hallucination without override chooses among actual and invented names with display RNG; the role/rank entry also draws core rn2(3).
Otherwise return the explanation mapped by trap_to_defsym.
